items.title: AI semiconductor selloff broadens across AMD, Broadcom and Nvidia
items.summary: Late-morning reporting shows AMD down about 10.2%, Broadcom down 6.5% and Nvidia down 4.2%, with the Nasdaq down 1.9%. Investors are reassessing AI infrastructure returns amid Nvidia leadership uncertainty and higher borrowing costs. These are intraday observations, not closing prices.

observations.label: Late morning November 13, intraday
observations.value: AMD -10.2%; AVGO -6.5%; NVDA -4.2%; Nasdaq -1.9%, AP

observations.label: Next indicators and invalidation
observations.value: Semiconductor breadth, volume, Treasury yields, AI capex guidance; broad sustained rebound would weaken the signal

items.key_finding: Chip weakness has broadened from Nvidia to major AI semiconductor peers.

items.title: IEA finds crude supply recovery alongside persistent diesel and tanker stress
items.summary: The IEA reports October global oil supply rose to 105.4 million barrels daily and inventories increased by 52 million barrels. Gulf exports recovered despite attacks, but onshore stocks remain unusually low, diesel near $180 per barrel in Europe and Middle East-to-Asia freight near records. This is evidence of recovering crude flows, not an end to physical shipping risk.

observations.label: October global supply
observations.value: 105.4 million barrels/day, up 2.3 million barrels/day month on month (IEA)

observations.label: October inventories
observations.value: +52 million barrels observed; onshore inventories lowest since at least 2016

observations.label: Gulf exports excluding Oman
observations.value: 18.4 million barrels/day, 26% below pre-war level

observations.label: Diesel and freight
observations.value: European diesel near $180/barrel, 77% above pre-war; Middle East-to-Asia crude tanker rates near records

observations.label: Next indicators and invalidation
observations.value: UKMTO/MARAD, verified transit and export volumes, diesel cracks, freight premiums and OPEC/IEA revisions; renewed export losses would undermine rebalancing

items.key_finding: Crude recovery is measurable, while diesel and tanker bottlenecks remain material.

items.title: October producer inflation stays elevated despite slower monthly growth
items.summary: October U.S. producer prices rose 0.3% month over month after a much larger September increase, while annual inflation reached 6.5%. The mixed report leaves restrictive interest-rate expectations relevant to technology valuations. Monitor underlying inflation and Treasury yields before treating one month's deceleration as a trend.

observations.label: October producer inflation
observations.value: +0.3% month on month; +6.5% year on year

observations.label: Rate context
observations.value: 10-year Treasury yield near 5.13% in morning coverage

observations.label: Next indicators and invalidation
observations.value: Core PPI, PCE, Fed guidance and 2Y/10Y Treasury yields; sustained disinflation would weaken rate-pressure thesis

items.key_finding: Cooling monthly PPI does not yet resolve persistent annual inflation and rate pressure.

items.title: Candel Therapeutics sinks after prostate-cancer FDA filing pushed into 2027
items.summary: Candel said ongoing FDA discussions and assay refinements now put its prostate-cancer therapy application in mid-2027, versus the prior fourth-quarter 2026 plan. Shares fell sharply after hours despite previously favorable late-stage data. The setback delays the regulatory milestone rather than establishing that the therapy failed; cash runway and FDA requirements are critical.

observations.label: Shares, Nov. 12 after hours (6:24–6:32 PM EST)
observations.value: Dow Jones reported CADL -38% to $5.15 at 6:24 PM; MarketChameleon reported -38.9% at 6:32 PM. Not an official session close.

observations.label: Filing timeline
observations.value: Mid-2027 BLA planned, contingent on ongoing FDA dialogue and assay refinement; previously Q4 2026.

observations.label: Financial capacity
observations.value: Company reported $203.1 million in cash and equivalents as of September 30 and expected operating runway into Q2 2028.

observations.label: Scientific evidence
observations.value: Company cited phase 3 result of 41% lower risk of prostate-cancer recurrence or prostate-cancer-specific death in a specified intermediate-risk subgroup; approval not yet granted.

observations.label: Next indicators / invalidation
observations.value: FDA agreement on assay and BLA requirements, revised filing milestones, cash burn, funding needs, confirmatory efficacy and safety data.

items.key_finding: A major regulatory-timing setback triggered a roughly 38% after-hours repricing, despite ongoing clinical promise.

items.title: UKMTO confirms November 11 tanker strike and evacuation off UAE Ras Al Khaimah
items.summary: UKMTO Warning 204-26, issued November 12, describes a November 11 projectile strike and engine-room fire on a tanker off Ras Al Khaimah. Reuters identified the vessel as MT Dominica Prosperity and reported all 22 crew safely evacuated. This verifies vessel damage, but not a new Strait closure or a quantified reduction in oil exports.

observations.label: Event date and UKMTO reporting
observations.value: November 11 incident reported in UKMTO Warning 204-26 on November 12; tanker struck about 14 nautical miles northwest of Ras Al Khaimah, UAE

observations.label: Confirmed physical outcome
observations.value: Engine-room fire and 22 crew evacuated safely; Reuters reported vessel MT Dominica Prosperity, Liberia-flagged, operated by Sinokor Maritime; no crew injuries reported

observations.label: Related maritime notices
observations.value: UKMTO also released Warning 203-26 about a separate November 10 tanker strike with casualties, and Update 001 to Warning 202-26; do not count repeated descriptions as additional incidents

observations.label: Energy-market context
observations.value: November 12 Brent $95.82, up about 3.3%, reflects geopolitical repricing alongside diplomatic statements; causal contribution from this individual attack is unquantified

observations.label: Risk and invalidation indicators
observations.value: Watch UKMTO/JMIC updates, fire and hull assessment, tanker movements and port operations, physical crude exports, freight/war-risk premiums, and XLE/XOP relative strength; normal transits and verified no export losses would limit supply effect

items.key_finding: A November 11 Gulf tanker attack is now corroborated as physical vessel damage with crew evacuation, without a verified new oil-flow shutdown.
